summary: In response to my last fragments (probably the bit about us worrying if LLMs have consciousness when we when we should be wondering why they don’t have a conscience) “Metalanguage” replied : we shipped the id and forgot the superego. classic software lifecycle. I don’t know what was on their mind, but their post immediately made me think of the classic 1956 movie Forbidden Planet.
takeaways: But that movie was particularly influential on sci-fi film-making and in the heart of its story is what happens when we nurture a thinking machine.

Sadly that’s no longer the case as he was deported from Ecuador on Friday: According to information released by his lawyer, Bini was intercepted by a car with four people who identified themselves as immigration agents.

To be thrown out of your home for scant reason is a heavy thing to bear, and the officials who did that have committed a serious offense. ❄ ❄ ❄ ❄ ❄ DDD Europe have released the video of Gien Verschatse interviewing Eric Evans and myself at the conference in June.
